nodes.label: Product Vision
nodes.rationale: A modern collaborative Kanban platform inspired by Jira, Linear and Trello — explicitly not a Jira clone, but a unique app with its own visual identity plus professional project management features.

nodes.label: MVP Scope
nodes.rationale: Authentication, user profiles, multiple boards, Kanban columns, drag & drop, todos, team members, invitations, task assignment, due dates, priorities and comments define production-ready v1.

nodes.label: Long Term Feature Roadmap
nodes.rationale: Workspace, notifications, calendar view, timeline view, sprint planning, attachments, activity history, AI assistant, analytics, templates, public boards and guest users — the list the board-centric schema must absorb without redesign.

nodes.label: Visual Design Goals
nodes.rationale: Rounded cards, soft shadows, smooth animations, modern typography, colorful board covers, elegant dark mode, minimalistic icons, spacious layouts — the app should feel closer to Linear than Jira while keeping its own identity.

nodes.label: Two-Year Architecture Test
nodes.rationale: Before implementing a feature, ask 'Will this architecture still work after two years of development?' — if no, redesign first. Quick hacks are rejected even when easier, because the project is intended as a real SaaS product rather than a portfolio CRUD app.

nodes.label: Core Product Principles
nodes.rationale: Fast, clean UI, modern design, scalable architecture, realtime collaboration, mobile friendly, keyboard friendly, accessible, beautiful animations.
